sql.value: select account_sets_id, subject_id, currency_id, begin_balance, begin_balance_for, begin_quantity from `@value(:balanceTableName)` where account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and auxiliary_detail_id = 0 and date = :startDate and currency_id = :currencyId

select account_sets_id, subject_id, currency_id, sum(credit) as credit, sum(credit_for) as credit_for, sum(credit_quantity) as credit_quantity, sum(debit) as debit, sum(debit_for) as debit_for, sum(debit_quantity) as debit_quantity from `@value(:balanceTableName)` where account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and auxiliary_detail_id = 0 and date between :startDate and :endDate and currency_id = :currencyId group by account_sets_id, subject_id, currency_id

select account_sets_id, subject_id, currency_id, end_balance, end_balance_for, end_quantity, year_total, year_total_credit, year_total_credit_for, year_total_credit_quantity, year_total_debit, year_total_debit_for, year_total_debit_quantity, year_total_for, year_total_quantity from `@value(:balanceTableName)` where account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and auxiliary_detail_id = 0 and date = (select max(date) from `@value(:balanceTableName)` f where f.date <= :endDate and f.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId) and currency_id = :currencyId

select date_format(ffu.create_date, '%m/%d') as day, count(1) total from fxy_financial_user ffu where ffu.create_date >= :date group by date_format(ffu.create_date, '%m/%d') order by min(ffu.create_date) asc

select date_format(ffau.relate_date, '%m/%d') as day, count(1) total from fxy_financial_agent_user ffau where ffau.relate_date >= : date and ffau.agent_id = : agentId group by date_format(ffau.relate_date, '%Y-%m-%d') order by ffau.relate_date asc

select date_format(ffas.create_date, '%m/%d') as day, count(1) total from fxy_financial_account_sets ffas where ffas.create_date >= :date group by date_format(ffas.create_date, '%m/%d') order by min(ffas.create_date) asc

select date_format(ffas.create_date, '%m/%d') as day, count(1) total from fxy_financial_account_sets ffas left join fxy_financial_agent_user ffau on ffas.creator_id = ffau.user_id where ffas.create_date >= : date and ffau.agent_id = : agentId group by date_format(ffas.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d') order by ffas.create_date asc
